_readme: First read of West Los Angeles College's program mapper (S344, SkyWaypoint). The procedure record (v1, 2026-10-08) carries one open question: whether programmap.wlac.edu opens to the reader. The census's probe (run 37198225537) loaded the college's page about the mapper and never the mapper itself; every mapper host probed that day refused the reader. One load of each; a refusal is the mapper service's and is not retried another way.

questions.mapper_open: Whether programmap.wlac.edu answers the reader, and how it lists programs and terms if it does.
